name: dispatch
description:
Message the other agent sessions on this machine (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot): find a session, send it a message, read replies, check your inbox.

Aliases: @dispatch, 派发.

Use Dispatch when the user asks to tell, ask or hand something to another session or agent, to check for messages from other agents, or to reply to a message that arrived through Dispatch.

interface.shortDescription: Message other agent sessions on this machine
interface.longDescription: Dispatch lets this session find the other agent sessions on this computer, send them messages, see whether they arrived and read the replies.
defaultPrompt: Any messages from other sessions for me?
